headline: Kellton Tech Solutions holds its annual general meeting for shareholders
hook: Annual general meeting concluded at Kellton Tech
summary: Kellton Tech Solutions Limited informed the stock exchanges about the proceedings of its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026. Such meetings are routine corporate events where shareholders vote on standard resolutions including financial statements, director appointments, and dividends. The filing confirms the completion of the statutory meeting without detailing specific outcomes. Indian retail shareholders of the company should review the official voting results once published to track governance and company updates.
why_it_matters: Routine corporate compliance update for Kellton Tech shareholders
